exchange.sent: What is non-signaling tester, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

answer.answer:
A non-signaling tester is supported here only as an RF-oriented test category: the sources list “Non-signaling RF” as a test type and contrast “Non-signaling - RF” with “Signaling - Protocol” and “Pre-conformance.” [13][100]
The product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding this distinction are whether to choose RF / production measurement tools such as R&S CMP180, R&S CMP200, R&S CMW100, or CMX500 / CMW500 for manufacturing, versus signaling / protocol / application tools such as R&S CMX500, R&S CMW500, and R&S CMsquares. [55][56]
For R&S CMP180, the decision includes which measurement options are needed, such as cellular / non-cellular measurement packs, spectrum analyzer, signal analysis, Bluetooth, WLAN, GSM, WCDMA, LTE, NR FR1, UWB, NB-IoT, and LP-IoT measurement options. [37][39]
For R&S CMP180, the decision also includes RF range and bandwidth configuration, including whether extended frequency range R&S CMP-K168 is needed for 6 GHz to 8 GHz and whether R&S CMP-K185 is needed for 500 MHz IF bandwidth. [38]
For R&S PVT360A, the decision includes whether the measurement need is WLAN, FR1 uplink, GSM, Bluetooth, spectrum analysis, MIMO, bandwidth up to 320 MHz for WLAN, or external frontend frequency extension. [43][44][46][29]
For R&S CMX500, the decision includes whether the task needs signaling, TX measurements, WLAN / NR / LTE options, application testing, BLER, PER, throughput, fading, AWGN, or protocol / application workflows rather than only RF non-signaling measurements. [84]
For CMX500 non-signaling / GPRF use, the decision includes whether GPRF generator functions, ARB / CW / Dual Tone / Replay `.wv` files, IQ recorder, or standalone TX measurements with R&S CMX-KM500 LTE Measurements and R&S CMX-KM600 NR FR1 Measurements are required. [61]
【推論】Understanding “non-signaling tester” determines the first product decision: select an RF / production measurement path when the task is “Non-signaling - RF,” and select a signaling / protocol path when the task is “Signaling - Protocol.” [100][55][56]

MVG integrates CMX500 OBT into WaveStudio Software Suite, simplifying 5G OTA signaling test processes › 重點摘要
- [[MVG]]（Microwave Vision Group）已將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 整合進 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]。
- 來源稱此整合讓使用者可直接使用 [[MVG]] antenna measurement systems 執行 [[5G NR]] 與 [[LTE]] [[OTA testing]] signaling tests。
- [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 被描述為支援 full stack generation and analysis of 4G、[[5G NR]]、[[WLAN]] 與 [[LTE]] signals。
- 與 [[MVG]] multi-probe measurement systems 搭配時，來源稱可在 real-world conditions 下進行 precise OTA testing。
- [[WaveStudio Software Suite]] 整合後，來源稱 [[MVG]] systems 可處理 [[5G NR Standalone]]（SA）mode、[[RedCap]] 與 [[LTE]]（FDD & TDD）signaling testing。
- 來源稱整合支援 multiple hardware configurations of the [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]，包括 `CMX Lite` 與 `CMX Pro`；但未提供正式料號、BOM 或與既有 [[R&S CMX500]] standard hardware configurations 的對照。
- 來源列出可支援的標準 / 場景包括 [[5G NR FR1]] SA、[[RedCap]] 與 [[LTE]]。
- 來源稱此整合可移除 earlier setups 的複雜度，減少 preparation and measurements 所需時間，並加速 development cycles。
- [[Pierre Jurek]] 以 [[MVG]] Chief Commercial Officer 身分表示，MVG 決定支援 different OBT configurations，並正快速擴充測試能力到 WiFi technologies，尤其是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]。
- [[Christoph Pointner]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Testers 身分表示，[[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 的 multi-band capabilities 可顯著簡化 OTA test setup。
- Press & media contact 為 [[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 公司資訊：2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue EUR 3.16 billion；2025-06-30 員工超過 15,000 人。

A non-signaling tester is supported here only as an RF-oriented test category: the sources list “Non-signaling RF” as a test type and contrast “Non-signaling - RF” with “Signaling - Protocol” and “Pre-conformance.” [13][100]
The product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding this distinction are whether to choose RF / production measurement tools such as R&S CMP180, R&S CMP200, R&S CMW100, or CMX500 / CMW500 for manufacturing, versus signaling / protocol / application tools such as R&S CMX500, R&S CMW500, and R&S CMsquares. [55][56]
For R&S CMP180, the decision includes which measurement options are needed, such as cellular / non-cellular measurement packs, spectrum analyzer, signal analysis, Bluetooth, WLAN, GSM, WCDMA, LTE, NR FR1, UWB, NB-IoT, and LP-IoT measurement options. [37][39]
For R&S CMP180, the decision also includes RF range and bandwidth configuration, including whether extended frequency range R&S CMP-K168 is needed for 6 GHz to 8 GHz and whether R&S CMP-K185 is needed for 500 MHz IF bandwidth. [38]
For R&S PVT360A, the decision includes whether the measurement need is WLAN, FR1 uplink, GSM, Bluetooth, spectrum analysis, MIMO, bandwidth up to 320 MHz for WLAN, or external frontend frequency extension. [43][44][46][29]
For R&S CMX500, the decision includes whether the task needs signaling, TX measurements, WLAN / NR / LTE options, application testing, BLER, PER, throughput, fading, AWGN, or protocol / application workflows rather than only RF non-signaling measurements. [84]
For CMX500 non-signaling / GPRF use, the decision includes whether GPRF generator functions, ARB / CW / Dual Tone / Replay `.wv` files, IQ recorder, or standalone TX measurements with R&S CMX-KM500 LTE Measurements and R&S CMX-KM600 NR FR1 Measurements are required. [61]
【推論】Understanding “non-signaling tester” determines the first product decision: select an RF / production measurement path when the task is “Non-signaling - RF,” and select a signaling / protocol path when the task is “Signaling - Protocol.” [100][55][56]

- PVT360A test setup 被放在 `Which system should I offer for O-RU testing?` 的 decision table 中，和 standalone VSA/VSG setup 對照。

- Ideal for regression and release testing，ensuring consistency and reliability across development stages。

- PVT360 or PVT360+ with high output power are described as ideal for small cell or macro-cell production testing，and can support testing of two O-RUs simultaneously。

- Rapid satellite movement。
- [[Doppler frequency shift]]。
- variable propagation delay。
- high path loss。
- advanced channel emulation。

MVG integrates CMX500 OBT into WaveStudio Software Suite, simplifying 5G OTA signaling test processes › 重點摘要
- [[MVG]]（Microwave Vision Group）已將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 整合進 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]。
- 來源稱此整合讓使用者可直接使用 [[MVG]] antenna measurement systems 執行 [[5G NR]] 與 [[LTE]] [[OTA testing]] signaling tests。
- [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 被描述為支援 full stack generation and analysis of 4G、[[5G NR]]、[[WLAN]] 與 [[LTE]] signals。
- 與 [[MVG]] multi-probe measurement systems 搭配時，來源稱可在 real-world conditions 下進行 precise OTA testing。
- [[WaveStudio Software Suite]] 整合後，來源稱 [[MVG]] systems 可處理 [[5G NR Standalone]]（SA）mode、[[RedCap]] 與 [[LTE]]（FDD & TDD）signaling testing。
- 來源稱整合支援 multiple hardware configurations of the [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]，包括 `CMX Lite` 與 `CMX Pro`；但未提供正式料號、BOM 或與既有 [[R&S CMX500]] standard hardware configurations 的對照。
- 來源列出可支援的標準 / 場景包括 [[5G NR FR1]] SA、[[RedCap]] 與 [[LTE]]。
- 來源稱此整合可移除 earlier setups 的複雜度，減少 preparation and measurements 所需時間，並加速 development cycles。
- [[Pierre Jurek]] 以 [[MVG]] Chief Commercial Officer 身分表示，MVG 決定支援 different OBT configurations，並正快速擴充測試能力到 WiFi technologies，尤其是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]。
- [[Christoph Pointner]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Testers 身分表示，[[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 的 multi-band capabilities 可顯著簡化 OTA test setup。
- Press & media contact 為 [[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 公司資訊：2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue EUR 3.16 billion；2025-06-30 員工超過 15,000 人。
- [[MVG]] 公司資訊：Microwave Vision Group 提供 electromagnetic waves visualization 技術、antenna characterization、radar signature evaluation 與 electromagnetic measurements 測試方案；營運於 10 個國家，90% sales from exports，revenues exceeding €100 million。

A non-signaling tester is supported here only as an RF-oriented test category: the sources list “Non-signaling RF” as a test type and contrast “Non-signaling - RF” with “Signaling - Protocol” and “Pre-conformance.” [13][100]
The product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding this distinction are whether to choose RF / production measurement tools such as R&S CMP180, R&S CMP200, R&S CMW100, or CMX500 / CMW500 for manufacturing, versus signaling / protocol / application tools such as R&S CMX500, R&S CMW500, and R&S CMsquares. [55][56]
For R&S CMP180, the decision includes which measurement options are needed, such as cellular / non-cellular measurement packs, spectrum analyzer, signal analysis, Bluetooth, WLAN, GSM, WCDMA, LTE, NR FR1, UWB, NB-IoT, and LP-IoT measurement options. [37][39]
For R&S CMP180, the decision also includes RF range and bandwidth configuration, including whether extended frequency range R&S CMP-K168 is needed for 6 GHz to 8 GHz and whether R&S CMP-K185 is needed for 500 MHz IF bandwidth. [38]
For R&S PVT360A, the decision includes whether the measurement need is WLAN, FR1 uplink, GSM, Bluetooth, spectrum analysis, MIMO, bandwidth up to 320 MHz for WLAN, or external frontend frequency extension. [43][44][46][29]
For R&S CMX500, the decision includes whether the task needs signaling, TX measurements, WLAN / NR / LTE options, application testing, BLER, PER, throughput, fading, AWGN, or protocol / application workflows rather than only RF non-signaling measurements. [84]
For CMX500 non-signaling / GPRF use, the decision includes whether GPRF generator functions, ARB / CW / Dual Tone / Replay `.wv` files, IQ recorder, or standalone TX measurements with R&S CMX-KM500 LTE Measurements and R&S CMX-KM600 NR FR1 Measurements are required. [61]
【推論】Understanding “non-signaling tester” determines the first product decision: select an RF / production measurement path when the task is “Non-signaling - RF,” and select a signaling / protocol path when the task is “Signaling - Protocol.” [100][55][56]
